# Map Shows Donald Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State After 19 Months

Published

Aug 20, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

Khaleda Rahman

National Correspondent

With less than three months to go before November's midterm elections, President Donald Trump's approval rating remains underwater in most states, bar a handful of reliably Republican strongholds that continue to give him positive marks on his job performance. [...] Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. As reported by USA TODAY on Aug. 12, a recent poll from Economist/YouGov placed the president's approval ratings at a "new low," with one in three Americans, or 33%, of respondents approving of his job performance, according to the results. USA TODAY described this as the "lowest approval rating" that the president has seen in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025. [...] ## How does Trump's approval rating compare with his first term?

According to results from now-defunct polling website FiveThirtyEight, Trump had a final approval rating of 34% when he left office in 2021. His approval average during his first term was 41%.
